capabilities: Export the active note as a vector PDF via command or ribbon icon
Print the note with theme styling on desktop (Paper or As-in-Obsidian looks)
Simplify unsupported elements (callouts, math, embeds) instead of failing the export
Configure output destination, filename scheme, page size, typography and pagination
Render frontmatter as a metadata block and add titles, page numbers and footers
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Full documentation, including a getting-started guide and troubleshooting, lives on an external documentation site. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer; page numbers and running footers need Chromium 131+. Windows and older Obsidian versions are untested for the theme-style path.
problem: Producing a clean, text-selectable PDF of a note normally means browser print dialogs or screenshot detours, and mobile has no practical path at all.

relations.evidence: The PDF writer is a small, pure engine vendored under src/vendor/kit/pdf/ (from obsidian-kit@0.8.0)

summary: One-command exporter that turns the active note into a clean, text-selectable vector PDF on desktop, iPhone and iPad, with no added letterhead.
